modifications: Introduce the Alpaca-specific download-needs and ordered JSON action-plan boundary, with five strategies for single-range bars, multi-range bars, boundary batches, exact asset lookups and corporate-action batches.

Group and deduplicate compatible requests only within independent steps, preserve requested slices and asof mappings, and centralize page limits, request-size policy and oversized-request splitting; existing pricing and metadata transports execute the plans.

Plan explicitly typed symbol lookups through one US-equity asset catalogue for batches of at least 100 symbols, while keeping untyped, CUSIP and asset-ID lookups exact; catalogue misses and ambiguous labels require a subsequent exact-lookup plan.

Cap corporate-action batches at 1,000 symbols, retain date and URL bounds, and support catalogue execution and oversized corporate-action request splitting through the existing ordered action boundary.
Plan explicit complete US-equity catalogue observations covering all statuses without an exchange filter.

Retain corporate-action logical rosters for shared balanced transport subdivision and include the shared 1,000-symbol physical cap in bar merge page estimates; preserve explicit logical and URL limits.
Plan literal ticker raw observations and single-session market split terms for bounded price checks.
Plan each full price history and its first-session confirmations under one symbol per request, preventing mapped aliases from suppressing historical sessions.
Separate co-requested members of known mapped pricing groups when their physical request would collide, preserving unrelated batching and the existing request-size limits.
Plan a single chronological trade on one New York date or an inclusive literal OTC interval, and the last trade on a bounded historical SIP interval under an explicitly dated mapping.
Plan a bounded single-CUSIP corporate-action discovery request using inclusive dates and complete US actions.
Construct literal SIP auction requests over published ticker dates and bounded multi-symbol SIP trade windows. Retain support for completed version 6 action plans.
